reviewProfile: UX implementation, browser assertions and visual inspection
scope: System-owned DEV target preparation only. Every new browser scenario fully intercepts HTTP, preserving operational applications, resources, business records and agent results.

navigation.ordering: The operational preparation panel precedes the existing DEV/QA/HML/PRD reference grid. The four references and their order remain unchanged.
navigation.recovery: Component remains mounted across System tabs; an external banner returns to the same uncertain request. Reason, original request body, persona and idempotency key survive reload.
navigation.history: The current operation and target proof are not a complete collection. Event history remains in Audit.

behaviorReviewed: Reference registration, prepared resources, current remote observation and application deployment are distinguished in words and facts. A prepared target does not claim an active application.
Context is checked before confirmation; source/contract/profile details are collapsed. Confirmation requires a reason and explicit checkbox.
System version, persona and operation changes invalidate a new decision while preserving the reason. Updating the target also refreshes the System header.
Lost acknowledgment reuses the original body, persona and key after reload. An unknown external result permits reconciliation of the same operation, without sending another prepare command.

Inactive/viewer contexts use real persona roles and read-only System state. Permission and source/ownership blockers are visible and link to the System repository without clearing unrelated URL parameters.
A failed reading preserves dated confirmed facts and blocks new decisions. Historical target proof is qualified separately from availability or deployment.
Pause/resume and pre-dispatch cancellation have separate confirmations; no resource removal is implied.
Eleven ENVIRONMENT_TARGET action labels and environment_operation target are translated; completion means DEV target prepared, not deployed or approved.

initialRun.scope: 20 new preparation cases plus six existing System-environment cases, before the operation-first panel reorder.

finalRun.scope: All twenty new cases after operation-first ordering and its positional assertion; the six reference-registration cases were not rerun for this final ordering-only change.

assertions: Focus return from an external recovery banner
Native label/textarea/checkbox associations and role-based disabled commands
Reason and unrelated query parameters retained across tabs
limits: No comprehensive screen-reader, keyboard-only or WCAG certification is claimed.

Full-page screenshots include the existing fixed shell/header and skip-link rendering at the capture scroll position, plus the Next development indicator. They do not establish an unobscured native viewport at every scroll position.
Primary/disabled button distinction, text wrapping, clear impediments and operation-before-reference ordering were inspected visually in six final captures.

outsideScope: DEV application deployment, live URL and active-version proof
Functional test execution or Development Finished approval

postTestSourceReview.change: The production TypeScript check required role:string, while Portal can hold string|undefined. The parent restricted the mount to role={role||''}: absent role remains unauthorized. No domain, command, layout or API behavior broadened.
postTestSourceReview.validation: Source-reviewed after the final browser run; no byte-exact browser rerun is claimed for this one-line restrictive default. Production TypeScript/Next validation belongs to the parent publication receipt.
